messages.cloud.title: Account & Cloud Saves
messages.cloud.conflict: The cloud save changed on another device and was not overwritten. Review it again before continuing.
messages.cloud.intro: Accounts are shared with game3. BackMir saves are stored separately. Uploading and loading saves remain manual after signing in.
messages.cloud.registered: Account created. Your saves remain local; you can upload them manually.
messages.cloud.loggedIn: Signed in. No saves were loaded or uploaded automatically.
messages.cloud.loggedOut: Signed out. Local characters are preserved.
messages.cloud.uploadAll: All characters listed above will be uploaded.
messages.cloud.replaceRemote: This will replace the cloud save from {{date}} for this account.
messages.cloud.emptyRemote: There is no cloud save yet.
messages.cloud.uploaded: Upload complete. Upload again manually to save later progress.
messages.cloud.noSave: This account has no BackMir cloud save yet.
messages.cloud.replaceLocal: This replaces all local characters. A local backup will be kept first, then you will return to Character Selection.
messages.cloud.loaded: Cloud save loaded. Your previous local save was backed up and can be restored in Account & Cloud Saves.
messages.cloud.noBackup: No backup from before a cloud load is available.
messages.cloud.restoreDescription: Restore all local characters from before the most recent cloud load, then return to Character Selection.
messages.cloud.restored: Local backup restored. The cloud save is unchanged.
messages.cloud.error.response: The cloud service returned an invalid response.
messages.cloud.error.timeout: The connection timed out. Check your network and try again.
messages.cloud.error.network: Cannot reach the cloud service. Check your network. Account sign-in requires the hosted game address.
messages.cloud.error.auth: Could not sign in. Check your username and password.
